author: Rob Gorden
text:
When I lose signal, I go to my Apps, find Libre, and "force stop" the app. It will warn you. Ignore the warning. Then reopen it.
Usually that will start showing readings again within minutes.

author: DeterminedPomelo1502
text:
Be certain to turn off Bluetooth & WIFI for one full minute. 
Turn both back on. 
IF still not working, turn cell off for 3-4 minutes.
